summary: A single nonzero original-coordinate cross singular direction with arbitrary same-bank self terms does not imply a finite negative half moment. For iid Uniform[0,1], K=(X-Y)^2 has E|K|^{-1/2}=infinity. The exact target form U^2+V^2+(X-Y)^2 has matrix spectrum {2,1,1,0} and is still uniformly paid by the independent two-square smoother, so the correction refutes only the half-moment shortcut and requires degeneracy rerouting.
